coachEvents.text: Jab, cross, lead hook, cross — straight time, thirteen bars. The four-count. Let the final cross land behind the hook.
Lead hook, cross, lead hook — time-and-a-half, eighteen bars. Hook, cross, hook. Keep the elbow up on both lead hooks.
Jab, cross, lead hook, rear hook — straight time, nine bars. Both hooks close the bar. Turn the hips, not the shoulders.
